units.source_text: 不论大竹七段多么警惕，在一盘对局中，名人总有机会强行挑战。

en.t: No matter how vigilant Otake 7-dan was, in the course of a game the Meijin always had a chance to force a challenge.

units.source_text: 白子也是在两角先下，这是很有趣味的棋。

en.t: White, too, had played first in two corners, making this a very interesting game.

units.source_text: 白子目外，黑子进入三三的左上角，

en.t: White played at the mokuhazushi point, and Black entered the three-three point in the upper left corner,

units.source_text: 为此六十五岁的名人在最后一盘胜负棋中打出了新的招数。

en.t: and because of this, the sixty-five-year-old Meijin brought out a new move in the final decisive game.

units.source_text: 果然，不久这角上风云变幻，把棋势弄得复杂极了。

en.t: Sure enough, before long the situation in that corner changed dramatically, making the overall position extremely complicated.

units.source_text: 连名人也觉得这是很重要的棋，

en.t: Even the Meijin felt that this was a very important part of the game,

units.source_text: 他避开复杂变化中的混战，选择了简明的着法。

en.t: so he avoided the melee of complicated variations and chose a clear, straightforward line of play.

units.source_text: 而后棋到中盘，基本是按黑子的招数下了，

en.t: After that, as the game reached the middle stage, it proceeded basically according to Black's plan,

units.source_text: 于是大竹七段使出浑身解数，不大工夫就自然而然制造出细棋的形势。

en.t: and Otake 7-dan then used every resource at his command, soon and quite naturally creating the conditions for a very close game.
